name: Flexible Circuit Technologies
old_description: A Leading Global Manufacturer of Flexible Circuits, Rigid-Flex, Flexible Heaters, Medical Catheters and printed electronics offering expert design services, value-added assembly, and turnkey product box builds.
about:
Founded in 2000 in Minneapolis, Minnesota, Flexible Circuit Technologies (FCT) operates as a global supplier of flexible circuit solutions. The company maintains its headquarters in Minneapolis while running a 485,000-square-foot manufacturing facility in Zhuhai, China.

FCT designs and manufactures single-, double-, and multilayer flexible circuits, rigid-flex circuits, flexible heaters, flat-flex cables, printed electronics, and medical catheter circuits. The company provides full-service electronic manufacturing services (EMS) including surface-mount and through-hole assembly, connector and wire assembly with epoxy coating, plastic molding, sub-assembly, and complete box builds. Its Zhuhai facility produces high-density PCBs, FPCs, rigid-flex, substrate-like PCBs (SLPs), and flexible heaters, supporting both low-mix/high-volume and high-mix/low-volume programs from prototype through production.

The company serves automotive, medical, wearable, industrial, consumer electronics, telecom/data, contract manufacturers, EMS providers, and product development labs. In automotive, FCT supplies EV battery monitoring solutions for vehicles ranging from transit to power tools. Medical customers use its flexible circuits in catheters, connected monitoring devices, and surgical tools. Wearable and consumer electronics programs leverage the firm's design expertise for miniaturized, high-reliability interconnects.

FCT differentiates itself through a hybrid model that pairs U.S.- and Asia-based application engineers and CAD teams—led by engineers with over 25 years of flexible-circuit experience—with Asia-based production. Director of Application Engineering Mark Finstad holds leadership roles in IPC flexible-circuit standards committees, giving the company direct influence on industry specifications. The firm emphasizes design-for-manufacturing consultation, supply-chain management, inventory stocking for just-in-time delivery, and comprehensive testing services.
